integrity: All rational determinant and trace-witness identities are exact; the all-parameter proof is analytic, and finite checks are supplementary. General Schur-multiplier certificate techniques are pre-existing.
scientific_limitations: Real radial parameter only; no intermediate Schatten-class sharp norms, arbitrary trees or complex-parameter classification. The special parameter T=1 is previously known. Independent bibliographic and mathematical validation not performed.
title: Sharp radial Schur amplification and a positivity threshold on finite and infinite stars
